tree.heading: Attorney General
tree.text: The term “Attorney General” means the Attorney General of the United States.

tree.heading: Compact
tree.text: The term “Compact” means the National Crime Prevention and Privacy Compact set forth in section 40316 of this title.

tree.heading: Council
tree.text: The term “Council” means the Compact Council established under Article VI of the Compact.

tree.heading: FBI
tree.text: The term “FBI” means the Federal Bureau of Investigation.

tree.heading: Party State
tree.text: The term “Party State” means a State that has ratified the Compact.

tree.heading: State
tree.text: The term “State” means any State, territory, or possession of the United States, the District of Columbia, and the Commonwealth of Puerto Rico.

notes.heading: Codification
notes.text: Section was formerly classified to section 14612 of Title 42, The Public Health and Welfare, prior to editorial reclassification and renumbering as this section.
